rationale: The failure likely stems from two issues: (1) a malformed locale path (/en-gb/en-int/) causing unexpected layout or redirect behavior, and (2) EU cookie/geo overlays blocking content and lazy-loaded product tiles. Normalizing to the international locale (/en-int/) and proactively accepting OneTrust cookies typically reveals the PLP. Moncler PLPs often lazy-load/infinite-scroll product tiles; enabling scroll and adding tolerant link-based fallbacks (anchors ending with .html within main) increases robustness without overfitting to brittle class names. PDP price/title selectors rely on semantic attributes where available and common fallbacks otherwise.
code_hints: Before waiting for PLP tiles, attempt to click cookie consent: try selectors in order (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler, then Accept All variants). Retry after a short delay if overlay persists.
If a geo/country modal appears, click confirm using provided close_geo selectors. Fallback: press Escape if modal role='dialog' is present.
Normalize the start URL to https://www.moncler.com/en-int/women/outerwear/all-down-jackets/ before navigation to avoid locale loops.
After navigation: wait for either a visible product grid or any anchor ending with .html within main; if neither appears, scroll once and re-wait.
Implement infinite scroll with stabilization: scroll, wait, and stop when the count of distinct PDP links (ending with .html under /en-int/) does not increase for 2 rounds.
When extracting PDP links from PLP, restrict to anchors under main whose href ends with .html and starts with https://www.moncler.com/en-int/. Deduplicate.
Use a standard desktop UA and viewport (e.g., 1366x900). Some items lazy-load; ensure intersection events by incremental scrolling.
On PDP, prefer itemprop='price' or data-test*='price'; remove currency symbols/spaces safely. Title fallback is generic h1.
Increase overall PLP timeout to accommodate dynamic load (e.g., 25-30s total), but abort if no anchors ending with .html appear after cookie acceptance and two scroll rounds.
